routes.label: Square symmetry and an attainable bound

question: Square \(ABCD\) has side length \(8\). Point \(E\) lies on \(BC\) with \(CE=6\), and \(P\) is a moving point on diagonal \(AC\). Find the minimum value of \(PB+PE\).
solution:
\(B\) and \(D\) are reflections of each other across \(AC\), so \(PB=PD\). Thus, \(PB+PE=PD+PE\geq DE\), and \(DE=\sqrt{8^2+6^2}=10\).

Segment \(DE\) lies within the square and joins points on opposite sides of diagonal \(AC\), so it intersects segment \(AC\). Choosing \(P\) at this intersection gives \(PD+PE=DE=10\), so the minimum value of \(PB+PE\) is \(10\).
